subject.title: [Feature]: Deeplink/contentIntent support in system.notify for Android nodes

question: Should Android `system.notify` support notification-tap deeplinks, and if so should the targets use the broader allowlisted Android URL-launch policy or only OpenClaw-owned app routes?
rationale: The current source proves the feature is missing, but wiring a caller-supplied deeplink directly into a `PendingIntent` would cross a native Android app-launch security boundary and likely add a new settings/policy surface.

options.title: Share an allowlisted deeplink policy
options.body: Use the same explicit allowlist/settings model being discussed for Android URL launch, and let `system.notify` reference that policy for notification taps.

options.title: Limit taps to OpenClaw-owned routes
options.body: Support notification taps only for internal OpenClaw app routes and leave arbitrary companion-app deeplinks to a separate command.

options.title: Reject notification deeplinks
options.body: Document that `system.notify` is display-only and keep Android deeplink launching behind a separate command design.

recommendation.title: Share an allowlisted deeplink policy
recommendation.body: Use the same explicit allowlist/settings model being discussed for Android URL launch, and let `system.notify` reference that policy for notification taps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee for this issue and the unresolved choice is product/security policy rather than a narrow code repair.
